Training data of Vision's R0 detector

The R0 detector (/usr/share/doors/vision/det-r0-traffic6-yolox-tiny-416.kmodel,
an experimental beta) was trained by the Doors project, from no pretrained
weights, on the traffic6_r0 dataset: images and annotations selected from the
two sources below and filtered to six classes (car, truck, bus, motorcycle,
bicycle, person). No image or annotation from them is in the Doors image.
None of their authors or publishers endorses Doors or this model, and they
give no warranty for it.

COCO 2017 annotations
    Copyright the COCO Consortium, https://cocodataset.org/
    Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
    licence, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
    Changes: filtered to the six classes above and relabelled 1-6.

Open Images Dataset V7 annotations
    Copyright Google LLC, https://storage.googleapis.com/openimages/web/index.html
    Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
    licence, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
    Changes: filtered to the six classes above; Car, Limousine, Van and Taxi
    folded into car, and Man, Woman, Boy and Girl into person, following
    Open Images' own class hierarchy; relabelled 1-6.

Images
    Photographs from Flickr, as listed by COCO 2017 and Open Images V7, each
    used under the licence its listing gives: Creative Commons Attribution
    2.0 Generic (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/), or "No known
    copyright restrictions" (Flickr Commons). Images under any other
    licence were left out. The licence labels are those the uploaders gave;
    neither dataset verifies them.
    The per-image list - each training image's licence, source URL and,
    where the source records one, its author - is the file ATTRIBUTION.tsv of
    the traffic6_r0 dataset (sha256
    2bc99bc8b2098a4f628fa8f3d0c08af5252a0d4cbdfb1eddaad9f9062e594c3e),
    published with the Doors release that carries the model.
